source.rationale: Case A' (the PLAIN miss offer), the only arm of the miss-company block this promote makes reachable. build-miss-member-offer ran and set miss_plain_offer with a single-entry plan. Decision fields derived from the contract BEFORE running the body: (1) the frozen phrase is APPENDED to the customer reply and to variables.response, and its prefix is byte-exact 'Would you like me to escalate' — the parser's regex contract /would you like me to escalate/i; a single miss names the company bold after 'to' and the team comes from the plan item's `team`, not from a hard-coded default. (2) selection_context stays NULL — no picker was shown, so the parser's member-pick arm must NOT open. (3) last_result_set is the ordinary compressed answer view, UNTOUCHED — Case A's `_mcBase.concat(_mcRows)` is the one concatenation on live and it is unreachable here because miss_member_offer is never set. (4) the pool identity is persisted: routing_roster_plan with the one entry, routing_company and routing_brand from it. (5) the miss_plain_offer / miss_roster_plan keys on the input item do NOT leak into the output — this node builds a fresh object literal.
